description: License allow-list of the JGates tools image (PLAN-image.md sections 2 and 5). image-gates.mjs checks every component of the image's SPDX SBOM against it. An identifier that is not listed fails the build; adding one is a decision of the user, never of the build. The descriptors of the linter engine are checked against it as well (their declared license, scripts/image-gates.mjs checkDescriptorLicenses): GPL only for a tool named in gplPackages or installed from Debian, a forbidden license only for a tool named in namedExceptions.

operatingSystem.rule: Debian packages come from Debian main, which only contains free software. Their per-file licenses are free-form names taken from the copyright files, so they are checked against forbiddenPatterns only; the apt Section of every installed package is verified to be main by the forbidden-content gate.

declaredByTool.rule: Dependency lists read from a compiled tool (Go modules, Rust crates, .NET assemblies) carry no license data. Their license is the one of the tool that contains them, which THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md lists with license and source URL.
